description: This file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for comment entity translations, including methods for querying data, preparing rows, and checking module requirements.

classes.name: CommentEntityTranslation
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for comment entity translations, extending FieldableEntity.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to fetch comment translation data.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares a migration row by fetching field values and handling title module integration.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields provided by this source.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the identifiers for the source data, namely entity_id and language.

methods.name: checkRequirements
methods.description: Checks for required modules 'comment' and 'node' and throws exceptions if missing.
